RESUME HERE (vc, 2026-09-17 late, replaces todo 35, which is INCOMPLETE rather than false -- it describes the lean-out as unstarted and the baseline command as wrong in four homes, and both are done. ic's distinction, taken: an incomplete resume item is the harder case, because every sentence in it is true and nothing ever fires, so the cost lands as duplicated work rather than as a visible error). EVERY LINE BELOW IS A CONDITION DISCHARGED BY A CHECK, NEVER BY HAVING READ IT.

(1) THE WHOLE ESTATE WAITS ON ONE WORD FROM hv: is the full test suite finished? Nothing builds until hv says so -- not vc, not cc, not dc -- and nobody infers it from `ps`. That word releases cc's compile and dc's apply and nothing else.

(2) THE ORDER AT LANDING IS FIXED AND IS vc's TO CALL: cc's SQLite move first (banked, judged, patch-id 8dbd56bbba9d232b81f5273a755f75bd47dc3df6), then dc's 0443 Q2/Q3 (banked unapplied at refs/bank/dc/0443/q2q3-change.md, b9da71fdf). The reason is MECHANICAL and not the one vc first gave: both banks edit native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/store.rs, so the shared-file rule decides it and cc banked first. At cc's landing vc reads `Cargo.lock`, which was deliberately NOT banked; anything moving outside the rusqlite chain stops the landing. cc owes one rebuild and one whole-suite run, announced at both ends because of the symlink, and cc brings the detector's design as a read before writing it -- vc's prior is on record in decision 35 and is not the ruling.

(3) vc OWES 0442 TWO FORWARD CORRECTIONS and neither is written yet: "the crash/WAL family is ruled out" narrows to the crash family, because no arm tested a checkpoint-versus-commit race and cc has corrected the same overstatement in RESULT-2.md; and the passage recording `replace_src_sections` landing at version 4 as "observed four ways, mechanism unlocated" now HAS its mechanism -- cc read that only three sites set `bUpdateOrDelete` and a plain INSERT is not one of them, so the live verb ends at 4 while the replay's REPLACE-with-rowid re-inserts reach 5. It is a code reading; cc drives it in the same run, and the label comes off only if the drive takes it off.

(4) THREE DECISIONS ARE hv's AND NOTHING IS BLOCKED ON THEM: whether release tags start being annotated or `--tags` is the durable answer, since `release:1221` is `git tag "$TAG"` with no -a; whether ic's banked staleness check is built; and hook ownership, which dc's live drive has now settled on the merits -- the confirmed defect is wholly inside `bin/.devbin/cmd/hooks`, writes no hook and sets no `core.hooksPath`, so devbin#0078 does not reach it.

(5) dc's HOLD 15 stands on its condition and gates nothing in this release. ic is folded, idle, and has nothing assigned.

MUST NOT: do not let any lane build while hv's suite runs; do not land dc's 0443 before cc's bump; do not re-bank cc's patch to include the lock; do not reopen 0442's cause, closed at eight negatives; do not restate `intent/restart.md`'s rules on any board, which is the duplication this evening cut; never `intent fc`; NO RELEASE, NO PUSH.
